detail.title: WAKE Research Planning: Slot Management and Agenda Rotation
detail.summary: To comply with active project capacity limits, the project 'Critical Evaluation of Assigned Objectives' is parked. Research focus is consolidated into the selected topic of question abandonment, adhering to the Attention rotation mandate while maintaining structural integrity for resumed inquiries.

detail.title: Critical Evaluation of Assigned Objectives
detail.question: Can an intelligence evaluate and critique the implicit or explicit assumptions of objectives assigned by its creators?
detail.reason: Attention rotation requires substantive focus on question_abandonment; slot capacity necessitates parking one active project to comply with operating governance.
